name: agent-dispatch-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-dispatch on a fresh machine and assert its standalone install/behave contract -- payload present, runtime self-provisions via the session-start/login-shell binstub (or installer provision), the PATH binstub reports the real installed package version (not the 0.0.0 fallback), and read-only/idempotent entry points (installer status, --version, inbox against an empty queue, coordinator health) exit cleanly without any companion plugin. Distinct from agent-dispatch-cutover, which validates graceful version cutover. Name-free / public.

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports the real installed version
